nodes.description: External advance() entry point that advances the protocol epoch by calling Bonding.step, Regulator.step and Market.step.
incentivized modifier that measures gas used and mints a DSD advance reward to msg.sender based on Chainlink ETH and gas price feeds.
deposit(uint256) pulls DSD from msg.sender via transferFrom and credits staged balance.
withdraw(uint256) sends DSD to msg.sender via transfer and then decrements staged balance.
bond(uint256) converts staged balance into bonded balance using totalSupply/totalBonded ratio.
unbond(uint256) converts bonded balance back to staged balance.
unbondUnderlying(uint256) converts underlying value back to staged balance.
vote(address,Candidate.Vote) records governance votes, creates candidates and places locks on voter accounts.
commit(address) verifies quorum and upgrades the proxy implementation to the approved candidate.
emergencyCommit(address) upgrades the proxy using super-majority approval without quorum.
upgradeTo(address) sets the implementation slot and delegatecalls initialize() on the new implementation.
setImplementation(address) validates the new implementation is a contract and writes the EIP-1967 slot.
migrateCoupons(uint256) converts coupon balances from an epoch into coupon underlying balances for msg.sender.
purchaseCoupons(uint256) mints coupon and coupon-underlying balances for msg.sender and burns the paid DSD.
redeemCoupons(uint256,uint256,uint256) redeems coupon underlying plus premium, applying a time-based penalty burn.
transferCoupons(address,address,uint256,uint256) moves coupon and underlying balances between accounts using coupon allowance.
approveCoupons(address,uint256) sets coupon allowance from msg.sender to a spender.
couponRedemptionPenalty(uint256,uint256) computes the decaying penalty using block.timestamp and the epoch period.
mintToAccount(address,uint256) mints DSD to an account and increases protocol debt when not bootstrapping.
burnFromAccount(address,uint256) pulls DSD via transferFrom, burns it and decrements total debt.
redeemToAccount(address,uint256,uint256) mints and transfers DSD to the redeeming account.
Bonding.step() snapshots total bonded supply and increments the epoch.
Market.step() expires prior coupons and initializes the expiration for current epoch coupons.
Regulator.step() captures the oracle price and grows, shrinks or holds the supply.
oracleCapture() reads the oracle price and falls back to bootstrapping or one when invalid.
initialize() sets the DSD provider oracle, pool, epoch boundaries and mints bootstrap balances.
blockTimestamp() returns block.timestamp and is used to derive the current epoch.
Storage.State _state holding epoch, balance, provider, accounts, epochs and candidates mappings.
Storage.State13 _state13 holding coupon underlying accounting and the cached price.
Storage.State16 _state16 holding the legacy oracle and the sushiswap epoch start.
_state.balance.debt tracking total outstanding protocol debt.
_state.balance.supply tracking total DSD stake supply.
msg.sender controls account ownership, staged balances, coupon balances and advance incentives.
block.timestamp drives epoch calculation, coupon penalty decay and governance timing.
delegatecall to newImplementation initialize() inside upgradeTo executes arbitrary code in proxy context.
external DSD transfer/transferFrom calls that hand control to a token contract during accounting.
external DSD mint/burn calls that modify token supply during state accounting.
multiplication/division arithmetic on supplies, debt, coupon amounts and prices.
inline assembly sstore writing the raw implementation slot.
value parameter of deposit/withdraw/bond/unbond functions.
couponEpoch parameter of coupon migration, redemption and penalty functions.
candidate parameter of vote/commit/emergencyCommit governance functions.
newImplementation parameter of upgradeTo.
startGas local in the incentivized modifier used to compute the gas based reward.
couponUnderlying local in purchaseCoupons splitting the coupon total in half.
price local in Regulator.step holding the captured oracle price.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines which account receives the staged balance in deposit().
msg.sender drives coupon migration accounting that is interleaved with coupon balance writes.
redeemCoupons pays out to msg.sender based on msg.sender coupon balances.
transferCoupons consumes msg.sender coupon allowance when not the owner.
the incentivized modifier mints the advance reward directly to msg.sender.
advance() executes under the incentivized modifier that mints to the caller.
advance() invokes Bonding.step() to snapshot bonded supply and increment the epoch.
advance() invokes Regulator.step() to capture price and adjust supply.
advance() invokes Market.step() to expire and schedule coupons.
the incentivized modifier calls mintToAccount(msg.sender, incentive) after execution.
couponRedemptionPenalty reads block.timestamp to compute timeIntoEpoch.
blockTimestamp() returns the raw block.timestamp value.
Bonding.step timing check uses epochTime derived from block.timestamp.
commit() timing checks depend on epoch values derived from block.timestamp.
commit() calls upgradeTo once quorum and approval checks pass.
emergencyCommit() calls upgradeTo after super-majority approval.
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on the new implementation, executing external code in proxy storage context.
upgradeTo calls setImplementation to persist the new implementation address.
setImplementation writes the EIP-1967 slot with inline assembly sstore.
deposit performs an external dollar transferFrom call to pull user funds.
withdraw sends dollar tokens to msg.sender before decrementing the staged balance.
purchaseCoupons multiplies and divides to split deposit plus premium into coupon portions.
redeemCoupons computes pro-rata coupon amount and penalty reductions with mul/div.
redeemCoupons mints and transfers DSD to msg.sender through redeemToAccount after balance accounting.
purchaseCoupons burns the paid amount via burnFromAccount external token calls.
burnFromAccount calls dollar.transferFrom to move tokens from the account.
burnFromAccount calls dollar.burn to destroy the pulled tokens.
mintToAccount calls dollar.mint on an external token contract.
redeemToAccount calls dollar.mint to create the redeemed DSD.
redeemToAccount calls dollar.transfer to pay the coupon portion.
Regulator.step obtains the oracle price through oracleCapture.
shrinkSupply increases the recorded debt state variable.
growSupply mints into total supply through increaseSupply.
initialize writes the legacy oracle and sushiswap epoch start into _state16.
initialize mints bootstrap balances to fixed addresses via mintToAccount.
the value parameter determines the staged balance credited in deposit.
the couponEpoch parameter selects which epoch coupons are redeemed.
the candidate parameter selects the governance target being voted on.
the newImplementation parameter is the address delegatecalled in upgradeTo.
startGas feeds the gas-based mint amount passed to mintToAccount.
couponUnderlying is credited to both coupon and underlying balances in purchaseCoupons.
the captured price local drives the grow/shrink decision in Regulator.step.

normalization_plan.reason: the value parameter only exists to size the staged balance credited by deposit.
the couponEpoch parameter is consumed by the coupon redemption accounting.
the candidate parameter is the governance target upgraded to by commit.
the newImplementation parameter is the address delegatecalled by upgradeTo.
startGas is a temporary measurement used only to compute the advance incentive mint.
couponUnderlying is a temporary split of the coupon total inside purchaseCoupons.
price is a temporary oracle snapshot used only for the supply decision in Regulator.step.
